0022600160.text: The Hawks, playing their eighth game of the season, are 3-4 overall, 2-2 on the road, and sit 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, after a loss in their last outing. The Pacers are 2-4, 0-2 at home, on a three-game losing streak, and 3rd in the Central, 3 games back. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Jalen Johnson (ankle) and Jock Landale (hip) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, following the Hawks' 2-1 series win in 2025-26 and their 129-124 loss in Indianapolis on January 31, the teams' most recent meeting.
